constraints.definition: CHECK ((((source_receipt IS NULL) AND (receipt_hash IS NULL) AND (source_sealed_at IS NULL)) OR ((source_receipt IS NOT NULL) AND (receipt_hash IS NOT NULL) AND (source_sealed_at IS NOT NULL))))
CHECK (((source_receipt IS NULL) OR (((source_receipt ->> 'outcome'::text) = ANY (ARRAY['EXHAUSTED'::text, 'CAPPED'::text, 'FAILED'::text, 'UNPROVEN'::text])) IS TRUE)))
FOREIGN KEY (workspace_id, refresh_id) REFERENCES canonical_refreshes(workspace_id, id) ON DELETE CASCADE
FOREIGN KEY (workspace_id, refresh_id, retry_of_attempt_id) REFERENCES canonical_level_attempts(workspace_id, refresh_id, id) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED
FOREIGN KEY (workspace_id, refresh_id, source_attempt_id) REFERENCES canonical_level_attempts(workspace_id, refresh_id, id) ON DELETE CASCADE
UNIQUE (workspace_id, refresh_id, write_id, entity_id, entity_level, date, granularity, source, measurement_window)
FOREIGN KEY (workspace_id, refresh_id, write_id) REFERENCES canonical_write_attempts(workspace_id, refresh_id, id) ON DELETE CASCADE

CHECK ((((selection_hash IS NULL) AND (source_sealed_at IS NULL) AND (attempt_dispositions IS NULL)) OR ((selection_hash IS NOT NULL) AND (source_sealed_at IS NOT NULL) AND (attempt_dispositions IS NOT NULL))))
FOREIGN KEY (workspace_id) REFERENCES workspaces(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
FOREIGN KEY (workspace_id, retry_of_refresh_id) REFERENCES canonical_refreshes(workspace_id, id) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED
FOREIGN KEY (workspace_id, id, selected_ad_id) REFERENCES canonical_level_attempts(workspace_id, refresh_id, id) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED
FOREIGN KEY (workspace_id, id, selected_adset_id) REFERENCES canonical_level_attempts(workspace_id, refresh_id, id) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED
FOREIGN KEY (workspace_id, id, selected_campaign_id) REFERENCES canonical_level_attempts(workspace_id, refresh_id, id) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED

CHECK ((((outcome IS NULL) AND (error_code IS NULL) AND (commit_manifest IS NULL) AND (outcome_hash IS NULL) AND (sealed_at IS NULL) AND (committed_at IS NULL)) OR ((outcome = 'FAILED'::text) AND (error_code IS NOT NULL) AND (commit_manifest IS NULL) AND (outcome_hash IS NOT NULL) AND (sealed_at IS NOT NULL) AND (committed_at IS NULL)) OR ((outcome = 'COMMITTED'::text) AND (planned_at IS NOT NULL) AND (error_code IS NULL) AND (commit_manifest IS NOT NULL) AND (outcome_hash IS NOT NULL) AND (sealed_at IS NOT NULL) AND (committed_at IS NOT NULL))))
FOREIGN KEY (workspace_id, refresh_id) REFERENCES canonical_refreshes(workspace_id, id) ON DELETE CASCADE
FOREIGN KEY (workspace_id, refresh_id, retry_of_write_id) REFERENCES canonical_write_attempts(workspace_id, refresh_id, id) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED

CHECK ((
CASE
    WHEN (outcome IS NULL) THEN ((error_code IS NULL) AND (commit_manifest IS NULL) AND (outcome_hash IS NULL) AND (sealed_at IS NULL) AND (committed_at IS NULL))
    WHEN (outcome = 'FAILED'::text) THEN ((error_code IS NOT NULL) AND (commit_manifest IS NULL) AND (outcome_hash IS NOT NULL) AND (sealed_at IS NOT NULL) AND (committed_at IS NULL))
    WHEN (outcome = 'COMMITTED'::text) THEN ((planned_at IS NOT NULL) AND (error_code IS NULL) AND (commit_manifest IS NOT NULL) AND (outcome_hash IS NOT NULL) AND (sealed_at IS NOT NULL) AND (committed_at IS NOT NULL))
    ELSE false
END IS TRUE))

triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER canonical_guard BEFORE INSERT OR DELETE OR UPDATE ON public.canonical_level_attempts FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION canonical_provenance.canonical_guard()
CREATE TRIGGER canonical_retention_event AFTER INSERT OR UPDATE ON public.canonical_level_attempts FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION canonical_provenance.canonical_extend_retention()
CREATE TRIGGER canonical_guard BEFORE INSERT OR DELETE OR UPDATE ON public.canonical_observations FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION canonical_provenance.canonical_guard()

CREATE CONSTRAINT TRIGGER canonical_observation_commit AFTER INSERT ON public.canonical_observations DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION canonical_provenance.canonical_validate_observation()
CREATE TRIGGER canonical_guard BEFORE INSERT OR DELETE OR UPDATE ON public.canonical_refreshes FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION canonical_provenance.canonical_guard()

CREATE CONSTRAINT TRIGGER canonical_selection_seal AFTER UPDATE ON public.canonical_refreshes DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED FOR EACH ROW WHEN (((old.source_sealed_at IS NULL) AND (new.source_sealed_at IS NOT NULL))) EXECUTE FUNCTION canonical_provenance.canonical_validate_selection()
CREATE TRIGGER canonical_guard BEFORE INSERT OR DELETE OR UPDATE ON public.canonical_write_attempts FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION canonical_provenance.canonical_guard()
CREATE TRIGGER canonical_retention_event AFTER INSERT OR UPDATE ON public.canonical_write_attempts FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION canonical_provenance.canonical_extend_retention()

CREATE CONSTRAINT TRIGGER canonical_write_seal AFTER UPDATE ON public.canonical_write_attempts DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED FOR EACH ROW WHEN (((old.sealed_at IS NULL) AND (new.sealed_at IS NOT NULL))) EXECUTE FUNCTION canonical_provenance.canonical_validate_write()
